description: This file contains the 'Currency' controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides functionality to display currency selection and handle currency change requests within the catalog front end.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for currency management, handling display and updates of currency settings in the store.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads currency data, sets up view data, and renders the currency selection interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles user input to change the current currency, updates session and cookie data, and redirects accordingly.
